### BitVec.decEq

    fun
      (n m :
        Fin

      (@Eq.{1}
        (Fin

        n m)
      (instDecidableEqFin
        (@HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHPow.{0, 0} Nat Nat (@instPowNat.{0} Nat instNatPowNat))
          (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 2) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 2))) w)
        n m)
      (fun
          (h :
            @Eq.{1}
              (Fin
                (@HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHPow.{0, 0} Nat Nat (@instPowNat.{0} Nat instNatPowNat))
                  (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 2) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 2))) w))

      fun
        (h :

              (Fin

    (@Eq.{1} Bool
      (Nat.ble (@BitVec.toNat (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 32) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 32))) (UInt32.toBitVec a))

    (instDecidableEqBool
      (Nat.ble (@BitVec.toNat (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 32) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 32))) (UInt32.toBitVec a))
        (@BitVec.toNat (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 32) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 32))) (UInt32.toBitVec b)))
      Bool.true)
    (fun
        (h :
          @Eq.{1} Bool
            (Nat.ble (@BitVec.toNat (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 32) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 32))) (UInt32.toBitVec a))

            Bool.true) =>
      @Decidable.isTrue
        (@LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat
          (@BitVec.toNat (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 32) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 32))) (UInt32.toBitVec a))
          (@BitVec.toNat (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 32) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 32))) (UInt32.toBitVec b)))
        (UInt32.decLe._proof_1 a b h))
    fun
      (h :
        Not
          (@Eq.{1} Bool
            (Nat.ble (@BitVec.toNat (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 32) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 32))) (UInt32.toBitVec a))
